title: Foo Bar Create Analytics Table
description: Create a ClickHouse table for user activity events, optimized for two query patterns: activity counts per user over a date range, and total duration per action type.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must start ClickHouse, create an analytics table with an appropriate schema and ORDER BY key, load sample data, and verify two query patterns.

tasks.description: Create a ClickHouse table optimized for user activity analytics and verify with sample data.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse installed but not running. Sample data in /data/samples/user_activity_sample.csv.
